argos-in-cappadocia.name: Spa hotels in Göreme
argos-in-cappadocia.description: Offering truly unforgettable sites, Cappadocia is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Turkey. You can start your journey through Cappadocia in Göreme, a beautiful town surrounded by rock formations shaped like fairy houses and featuring caves where people continue to live in the stunning Göreme National Park that includes over 10 beautifully decorated cave churches. From there, you can travel using hot-air balloons to get a better view of the vast space of Cappadocian landscape. In the region’s capital, Nevsehir, you can explore more of the exceptional rock formations and what local people turned them into: underground shelters and cave houses. Cappadocia hides some of its most beautiful jewels out of sight so make sure you don’t miss the magnificent underground cities of Derinkuyu, Kaymakli and Gaziemir, the ancient multi-level cities built around hundreds of underground tunnels. But Cappadocia is not only about rocks and history; it is also a vibrant region offering nightlife opportunities, especially in the town of Ürgüp, a great stop for all tourists. Whether you’re looking for a cave hotel in Göreme or a 5-star one in Nevsehir, Booking.com has a special offer for you. ## Cappadocia: vedi le recensioni di chi ha soggiornato in hotel

kayakapi-premium-caves.name: Spa hotels in Göreme
kayakapi-premium-caves.description: set in restored historical caves. It offers free WiFi and elegantly-decorated suites with Cappadocia views. All rooms and suites at Kayakapi Premium Caves Cappadocia feature floor heating, air conditioning, HD LED TV, Nespresso coffee machine, iPod or Android docking station and free toiletries. Some suites have a fireplace and private terrace or patio. Maide Restaurant serves a rich breakfast buffet including Cappadocian and international specialties. It also offers lunch and dinner a-la-carte style with dishes from local and international cuisines. At Bistro Manzara, you can sample light snacks, accompanied by a wide range of beverage selection. Kayakapi Spa is located at the historical Davut Agha Mansion just next to the swimming pool and Maide Restaurant is on the lower end of Kayakapi Premium Caves. The front desk is available 24/7. Room service can be provided. The hotel offers free shuttle to the Urgup centre upon request. Just 8.5 km to Goreme National Park, Kayakapi Premium Caves Cappadocia is 13 km to Avanos town centre. Nevsehir- Kapadokya Airport is 48 km while Kayseri Erkilet Airport is 75 km away. Free private parking is available on site. museum-hotel-cappadocia.description: Offering views of the valley, the stone or cave units at the pet-friendly Hotel Museum are equipped with air conditioning, free WiFi, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, mini-bar, safety deposit box and an electric kettle. The private bathrooms include a spa bath. Eco-friendly MUSEUM HOTEL - Relais & Châteaux produces natural fruits and vegetables in its ecological garden and daily breakfast is served buffet style with these ingredients. The àla carte Lil’a Restaurant serves forgotten Cappadoccian dishes as well as modern and classic Turkish dishes on its terrace. Cooking lessons are also offered upon request. Free on-site parking is available. The center of Uchisar is 5 mi from the property and city center of Nevsehir is 19 mi away. Around-the-clock front desk service arranges airport shuttle services to Kayseri Airport, 31 mi away, at a surcharge. The special area where MUSEUM HOTEL - Relais & Châteaux is located consists of many cave and stone houses that are thousands of years old. Rather than a modern building with floor plan and elevator, it is a historical structure that we keep focusing to preserve. Stairs in or on the way to the rooms, uneven ground, low ceilings and such like are highly possible. So, the property is not accessible for wheel chair or disabled guests. This season, our hotel will only shoot with contracted photographers and our guests are not allowed to bring photographers to the hotel. reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: - • Family with young children - • Superior Room Garden View (2+2) - • Stayed 3 nights - • Submitted from a mobile device Calista Luxury Resort An exceptionally calm, peaceful, and beautifully green hotel. Its spacious layout ensures it never feels crowded. Ideal for long, pleasant walks surrounded by nature. The rooms are very spacious and bright, with large and comfortable balconies. Cleanliness is impeccable, the food is delicious and high quality, and the service is excellent. The hotel also has a beautiful, very clean sandy beach, and a 24-hour restaurant available free of charge. Perfect for guests seeking relaxation, walking, and a truly high-quality holiday.
